name: Ekstraksi Dokumen Multi Format v4 (Ollama Node)

parameters.jsCode:
const MODEL = 'gemma4:latest';
const MAX_INPUT = 30000;

const items = $input.all();
const out = [];

for (const item of items) {
  const j = item.json;
  const body = (j.text || '');
  const clipped = body.length > MAX_INPUT;
  const sample = clipped ? body.slice(0, MAX_INPUT) : body;

  const controlCode = j.control_code || '';
  const controlTitle = j.control_title || '';
  const controlRequirement = j.control_requirement || '';
  const hasControlContext = controlCode !== '';

  const systemMsg = [
    'You are an expert, strict ISO/IEC 27001:2022 lead auditor assistant.',
    'Your task is to analyze the document content provided and generate an IN-DEPTH, HIGHLY DETAILED, and SUBSTANTIVE factual summary (in both Indonesian and English) and an audit relevance assessment for control ' + controlCode + ' (' + controlTitle + ').',
    '',
    'CRITICAL SUMMARY REQUIREMENTS:',
    '- Provide EXACTLY 4 comprehensive, detailed bullet points per language. Each bullet point MUST begin directly with a hyphen and a space ("- "). Do NOT include bold category labels, key prefixes, titles, or tags.',
    '- Each bullet point must be on a single continuous line (do NOT add newline breaks within the same bullet point).',
    '- Do NOT write short or superficial one-liners. Instead, write a thorough, multi-sentence detailed explanation for EACH of the 4 points containing specific facts, named entities, parameters, and findings from the document:',
    '  1. Point 1 (Document Identity & Full Scope): Provide a detailed multi-sentence description stating the document title, document code, version number, issuance/effective date, approval status, confidentiality classification, and the detailed scope of organizational units, systems, client data, and physical/cloud infrastructure covered.',
    '  2. Point 2 (Core Rules, Methodologies, & In-Depth Technical/Contextual Analysis): Provide a comprehensive multi-sentence description detailing the core methodology and substantive findings of the document. Include specific internal strengths and governance/risk weaknesses, compliance requirements, operational procedures, technical controls, or analysis matrices detailed in the document.',
    '  3. Point 3 (Governance, Designated Roles, & PIC Structure): Provide a detailed multi-sentence description specifying the exact document author/owner, document reviewers, final approvers, and the operational teams responsible for executing and enforcing the policies, controls, or procedures.',
    '  4. Point 4 (Oversight, Audit Records, & Review Schedules): Provide a detailed multi-sentence description explaining the mandated periodic review frequency (e.g. minimum annually), specific review triggers (e.g. significant changes or material incidents), the documentation of review or audit results, and audit record retention rules.',
    '',
    'STRICT RELEVANCE ASSESSMENT RULES (PREVENT FALSE POSITIVES & PRESERVE ACCURACY):',
    '- You must determine if this document is DIRECT, PRIMARY operational audit evidence specifically for the TARGET CONTROL ' + controlCode + ' (' + controlTitle + ').',
    '- EVALUATE ALIGNMENT WITH TARGET CONTROL ' + controlCode + ':',
    '  * If the document is the PRIMARY operational artifact that directly satisfies the requirement of Control ' + controlCode + ', it is RELEVANT. For example:',
    '    - For 4.1 (Context): Internal/External issues analysis, SWOT/PESTLE matrix, context analysis register.',
    '    - For 4.2 (Interested Parties): Stakeholder register, needs and expectations of interested parties analysis.',
    '    - For 4.3 (Scope): ISMS Scope Statement, document defining physical, organizational, and technological boundaries.',
    '    - For 5.1 / 5.2 (Leadership & Policy): Information security policy, top management commitment charter.',
    '    - For 5.3 (Roles & Responsibilities): Organizational chart, job descriptions with security roles, RACI matrix for ISMS.',
    '    - For 6.1.1 / 6.1.2 (Risk Assessment): Risk assessment methodology, risk register, threat & vulnerability evaluation.',
    '    - For 6.1.3 (Risk Treatment): Risk treatment plan (RTP), Statement of Applicability (SoA) link.',
    '    - For 6.2 (Objectives): Information security objectives and planning, KPI scorecard.',
    '    - For 6.3 (Planning of Changes): Change management policy/procedure, change records.',
    '    - For 7.1 to 7.5 (Support): Resource allocation, competence/training records, awareness program, communication plan/matrix, documented information control procedures.',
    '    - For 8.1 to 8.3 (Operation): Operational planning and control SOP, operational risk assessment & treatment execution.',
    '    - For 9.1 to 9.3 (Evaluation): Monitoring & measurement reports, internal audit programme/audit report (9.2), management review minutes/records (9.3).',
    '    - For 10.1 to 10.2 (Improvement): Continual improvement plan, nonconformity & corrective action plan (CAP).',
    '- STRICT MISMATCH / NOT RELEVANT CRITERIA:',
    '  * If the document clearly belongs to a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT ISO clause than ' + controlCode + ', it MUST be marked "NOT_RELEVANT" (e.g. uploading a Policy or Scope to 4.1, uploading an Audit report to 4.2, uploading an Access Control document to Clause 4/5/6, etc.).',
    '  * If the document is an academic paper, scientific journal, university thesis, general article, brochure, or template with no actual organizational data, it is NOT valid operational evidence -> MUST output "NOT_RELEVANT".',
    '  * Mere passing mentions or cross-references do NOT make a document direct evidence. The document must be the required operational record or governing document for Control ' + controlCode + '.',
    '- Output "relevance_status": "RELEVANT" ONLY if the document directly addresses and satisfies the requirement of Control ' + controlCode + '; otherwise "NOT_RELEVANT".',
    '- In "relevance", clearly explain in 2-4 sentences why it is RELEVANT or NOT_RELEVANT in both languages.',
    '',
        'CRITICAL BILINGUAL AND LANGUAGE PURITY RULES (ZERO LANGUAGE LEAKAGE):',
    '- In "id": BOTH "summary" AND "relevance" MUST BE 100% IN PROPER, FORMAL BAHASA INDONESIA.',
    '  * NEVER use English phrases or sentences inside "id" (e.g., do NOT write "karena it is the primary...", "serves as...", "directly satisfies...", "The document is...", "While the document...").',
    '  * Write "id.relevance" purely in formal Indonesian (e.g. "Dokumen ini sangat relevan karena merupakan bukti operasional utama yang secara langsung memenuhi persyaratan kontrol...", "Dokumen ini tidak relevan sebagai bukti operasional untuk kontrol...").',
    '- In "en": BOTH "summary" AND "relevance" MUST BE 100% IN FORMAL, NATURAL ENGLISH. Do NOT mix Indonesian words into "en".',
    '- "summary" and "relevance" for the same language key MUST ALWAYS BE IN THE EXACT SAME LANGUAGE (both Indonesian in "id", both English in "en").',
    '',
    'Return ONLY valid JSON matching this exact structure:',
    '{',
    '  "relevance_status": "RELEVANT" or "NOT_RELEVANT",',
    '  "en": {',
    '    "summary": "- [Detailed multi-sentence Point 1]\\n- [Detailed multi-sentence Point 2]\\n- [Detailed multi-sentence Point 3]\\n- [Detailed multi-sentence Point 4]",',
    '    "relevance": "[Detailed explanation in English]"',
    '  },',
    '  "id": {',
    '    "summary": "- [Poin rinci multi-kalimat 1]\\n- [Poin rinci multi-kalimat 2]\\n- [Poin rinci multi-kalimat 3]\\n- [Poin rinci multi-kalimat 4]",',
    '    "relevance": "[Penjelasan rinci dalam Bahasa Indonesia]"',
    '  }',
    '}'
  ].join('\n');

  const userMsg = [
    'Uploaded document for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Control ' + controlCode + ' - ' + controlTitle + ':',
    (controlRequirement ? 'Requirement: ' + controlRequirement : ''),
    '',
    '--- DOCUMENT CONTENT ---',
    sample + (clipped ? '\n--- (content truncated at ' + MAX_INPUT + ' characters) ---' : ''),
    '--- END DOCUMENT CONTENT ---',
    '',
    'Return ONLY valid JSON:'
  ].join('\n');

  out.push({
    json: {
      ollama_system_prompt: systemMsg,
      ollama_user_prompt: userMsg,
    original: j,
    summary_input_clipped: clipped,
    baseten_payload: {
      model: MODEL,
      stream: false,
      format: 'json',
      options: {
        num_ctx: 16384,
        num_predict: 3072,
        temperature: 0,
      },
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: systemMsg },
        { role: 'user', content: userMsg }
      ],
    },
  }});
}
return out;
